meta.name: FM Landings Block Inventory
meta.notes: Agents may only assemble landings from these block types until inventory expands.

blocks.description: Primary above-the-fold pitch with optional dual CTAs. No nested table/chart — sequence separate blocks (see assembly.md).
blocks.figma: 29987:341692 Market Header (content subset; chart = planned market-hero)
contentRules: Title should be one clear promise; avoid stacking multiple claims.
Prefer subtitle (one paragraph) when Figma shows a single lead; use bullets only for campaign TZ lists.
Do not embed table/chart/media props — use type table or planned market-hero / spread-cards.
If performance/cost claims appear, compliance must allow them.

blocks.description: Market Header: structured market landing hero with an optional indicative quote panel and Trustpilot summary.
contentRules: Use approved or explicitly illustrative pricing only; label non-live values as indicative.
Validate rating and review count freshness before public campaign use.
Keep market copy in the landing content document; do not use Figma sample marketing copy.

blocks.description: USP (Why Fusion) or simple feature cards from Cards frame.
contentRules: Default variant is usp. Pass variant feature only for simple benefit cards.
variant usp only for Fusion unique selling points (Figma rule).
USP: prefer 3–4 items; >4 scrolls horizontally.
Keep descriptions scannable (1–3 sentences).

blocks.description: Markets-style data table (header + rows) per Tables frame rules.
contentRules: Use instrumentsColumns / defaultInstrumentsColumns for headers.
Use for spreads/markets lists. Comparison: variant compare.
Prefer symbol cells as { title, meta } for pair name + description.

blocks.description: How it works process — default horizontal (Final Pages 29987:339011); vertical timeline optional.

defaults.title: How It Works
defaults.subtitle: Opening a trading account with Fusion Markets is simple:

contentRules: Section H2 is owned by the block (default “How It Works”). Landings omit title unless TZ has a different heading.
Step item titles use sentence case. Do not Title Case them per slug.
Default orientation is horizontal (centered H2 + 3 columns + dual CTA).
Prefer 3 steps; short titles; first step active purple, rest inactive gray.
Vertical only when Figma shows left timeline.
Section H2 defaults to FAQ. Override only when TZ names the section.
Questions should match real objections; answers plain language.
Use approved compliance wording when answering product/risk questions.
Section H2 is owned by the block (default “Ready to start trading?”).
One dominant action; secondary is optional and quieter.

blocks.description: Funding methods section with a shared heading and provider row.

defaults.title: Our Funding Methods
defaults.subtitle: Fund your account securely with a range of convenient payment methods.

contentRules: Section H2 is owned by the block (default “Our Funding Methods”).
Use only funding methods confirmed for the landing's target jurisdiction.
Replace provider text with approved brand assets when the asset bundle is available.

blocks.description: Legal / risk footer text. Strongly recommended on every marketing landing.

defaults.text: CFDs are complex instruments and come with a high risk of losing money rapidly due to leverage.

contentRules: Omit text to use the shared CFD warning in lib/block-defaults.ts.
Prefer approved disclaimer language from brand/compliance.md when available.
Do not omit on campaign pages intended for external sharing.

planned.description: Homepage «Our spreads»: H2 + lead + Tabs_Text + TV_Card rail (desktop) / stack (mobile) + Spreads Tool link. Content varies (pairs/tabs); structure is fixed. Same block on promo/market landings.
planned.figmaNotes: Not the same as Markets DataTable (type table). Do not implement as a one-off table in content.

Trustpilot / TV / Google ratings row

OS download strip or Store download button row (Windows/Mac/Linux/iOS/Android/Web). Full-bleed bar on MT5 Overview; badges in device heroes.

Multi-panel Comparison Table: Classic vs Zero, Retail vs Pro; mobile tabs.
Unequal USP/feature bento grid (large + small cards).
Two-column explainer: icon+title | paragraphs, or image | long copy.
Quotes / review proof (alias of review-rail / employee quote bands)
Material icon + short heading feature mosaic (optional center visual). MAM key features — not isometric USP cards.
Short mid-page legal/advisory strip (e.g. under DupliTrade hero). Not full disclaimer/footer legal.
Grid of Desktop Funding cards (deposit/withdrawal methods). Same shell; content = method metadata.
FAQ-style accordion embedding DataTable per category (All Products, Session Time, etc.).
Savings / broker compare widget (selectors + results). Premium, Fusion+, Broker Comparison Tool.
Fusion+ signal master / copier leaderboard or metrics cards.
Trading calculators workspace: tabs + form (selectors/fields) + results card. Margin/pip/etc via tab content.
Live & historical spreads product UI (quote header + filters + chart). Not marketing spread-cards rail.
Directory grid of client tools (calculators, spreads, calendar…). Client Hub Tools overview.
Trustpilot summary + review cards rail (avatar, stars, quote).
Award crests marquee and/or award spotlight cards with year tabs.
Image/video carousel with navigate dots (careers hero, homepage media, awards).
Blog listing card + featured variant (labels, tags, read time). Fusion Blog homepage.
Email subscribe band (field + primary + legal). Blog homepage.
Open roles list + apply CTA/email. Careers page.
Key metrics strip (big number + label). Careers / about.
